defects.title: WaiterPWA bill sheet lacks split payment (hesap bölme) functionality
defects.invariant: Waiter must be able to split a check by items/seats and send partial payments, matching Cashier split-payment capability
defects.mechanism: WaiterPWA bill.js and index.html show no split UI — bill sheet (lines 132-177 in index.html) has buttons for add items, party size, help, move table, send to cashier, close — no split button; Cashier split-payment.js exists at CA/payments/split-payment/split-payment.js with product-based splitting (line 1566 in pazar-uzmani.md)
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA bill sheet adds split button/action allowing item/seat-based division and partial send-to-cashier, with server-side split order support

limitations: Static review only; Cashier split-payment.js not examined for API contract; server-side split order endpoint not verified
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
